up: Retrieve all distinct molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5727678. For each molecule, provide its ChEMBL molecule ID, preferred name, molecule type, and canonical SMILES (if available). Do not include duplicate rows.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727678';
